page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r8i.xlarge is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features an x86_64 architecture utilizing an Intel Xeon 8475B processor running at a base clock speed of 2.7 GHz. The instance is configured with 4 dedicated physical cores and 4 vCPUs, meaning hyperthreading is disabled with a 1.0 thread-per-core ratio.

This instance is equipped with 32.0 GB of RAM, providing a high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per core. It does not include local storage, requiring external block storage volumes for operating system and data storage needs. There are no integrated GPUs. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 4 Gbps.

The dedicated CPU allocation and high memory density offer a stable environment for memory-intensive workloads without the risk of resource contention from hyperthreading. This hardware profile is qualitatively cost-efficient for applications requiring significant memory capacity relative to compute power, such as medium-sized databases, in-memory caching layers, enterprise applications, and memory-bound data processing tasks.
